requirement: One action row under the last finished answer of any kind: a Help answer and a / command result end with dsh's copy, thumbs, branch and clock like an agent reply, until a new request is sent

oracle.ref: PR #1188 (fix); fix evidence: tasks/evidence/answer-actions-2026-10-12/ (before/after screenshots on a real dsh page: agent reply, /help answer, / command result, row kept while typing, row moved after a new request, hover and focus)
oracle.invariant: S1: the row gets answerId from done; a press shows the rating at once and posts {rating} to /api/assistant/turns/<id>/rating; a refusal puts it back; pressing the recorded rating posts {rating: null} and clears it. S2: the restored answer carries answerId, rating and at (epoch ms of the stored answer); a bad date carries no at; a live answer's at is the clock when it finished; the askBack row's at is the clock when it was given. S3: text for done, stopped-with-words and askBack; null otherwise. S4: every source test passes; the focus rule is outline 1px solid var(--ring) with no box-shadow. S5: the fork specs pass (CI=true corepack pnpm install --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile inside the submodule first).
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: rating: the answer id comes from done
rating a row that has no answer id yet does nothing
a restored answer brings back its id, its rating and when it was written
an answer carries the time it finished
the action row shows under a finished answer only
a finished answer ends with dsh's own action row
on the start screen each Help row sits in a flow item of its own
a question and the reply to a bare /help are upserted as an exchange
the action row under an answer takes focus as one 1px stroke
dsh's row sits as far under a Help answer as under an agent reply
